sloka: आश्चर्यमिव पश्यामि यस्यास्ते वृत्तमीदृशम् ।आचरन्त्या न विदृता सद्यो भवति मेदिनी ॥२-३५-१४॥
transliteration: āścaryamiva paśyāmi yasyāste vṛttamīdṛśam ।ācarantyā na vidṛtā sadyo bhavati medinī ॥2-35-14॥

translations.english: It is a wonder that the earth does not split right away when you are perpetrating such an (abominable) act.
